A riscv64 Linux booting in your browser with TinyEMU/JSLinux (© 2017-2019 Fabrice Bellard) and a static radare2 (© pancake) preinstalled.

Try r2 /bin/busybox, then aaa and pdf @ main. All r2 tools are available: rasm2, rabin2, rax2, ragg2, ...

Uploaded files appear in /mnt/tmp. After adding this page to the Home Screen, open it once while online: the complete disk and runtime are cached locally. Wait for the Cache progress button to return to ClrCache before going offline. Nothing is executed outside this page. Run resize in the shell after resizing the window, rotating the screen or toggling the keyboard. Add ?mem=256 to the URL for more guest RAM.
